selector_meta.method: student attention rollout vs cached teacher attention rollout, per-image rank agreement
selector_meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (attention rollout); Li et al. EMNLP 2021 (Dynamic KD, sample-level teacher use)
selector_meta.why: an image where the student attends to different evidence than the teacher is where the teacher's soft label carries what the student lacks, so it gets the whole teacher (H-C22 interpretability primary)
selector_meta.vs_maskedkd: chooses which images get the whole teacher, not which tokens; MaskedKD gives every image K tokens
selector_meta.prior_art: Dynamic KD picks images by student entropy (builtin dynkd); here by student-teacher attribution agreement
